title: Top score per course
statementMd:
For each course show the highest score and the student id who earned it (all students if tied).

Expected columns: `course_id`, `student_id`, `score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.score FROM enrollments e WHERE e.score = (SELECT MAX(e2.score) FROM enrollments e2 WHERE e2.course_id = e.course_id);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
